Skip tests and examples that need a Proton Drive session

Source: R/auth.R
pd_available.Rd

Helpers for code that should only run when the CLI is installed and signed in, such as package tests or vignettes.

Usage

pd_available()

skip_if_no_pd()

Value

pd_available() returns TRUE or FALSE. skip_if_no_pd() is called for its side effect within testthat tests.

Examples

pd_available()
#> [1] FALSE
